$:set -euo pipefail
p=user/codespaces/shiny-robot-v64x5jj4v4q2x96
state(){ gh api "$p" --jq .state; }
for i in $(seq 1 35); do s=$(state); echo "STATE=$s"; case "$s" in Available) exit 0;; Shutdown) gh api --method POST "$p/start" --jq .state; break;; Starting|Provisioning) break;; ShuttingDown) sleep 4;; *) echo "UNEXPECTED_STATE=$s"; exit 2;; esac; done
for i in $(seq 1 30); do s=$(state); echo "READY_CHECK=$s"; [ "$s" = Available ] && exit 0; sleep 4; done
exit 1
